source: Pew Research Center. American Trends Panel Wave 70, fielded July 13-19, 2020.
method: Population is respondent's religious tradition (F_RELTRAD), restricted to respondents who attend religious services at least monthly (the survey's own SERMONISSUE skip pattern, gated on XATTEND_W70). Share answering "yes" to SERMONISSUE_b_W70 ("in the past few months have you heard any sermons in person, online, or on TV expressing support for the recent Black Lives Matter protests"); refused excluded from each row's denominator. Groups under 30 valid respondents omitted. Weighted by the dataset's own WEIGHT_W70 variable.
